name: Ootori Kikyou
source:
The protagonist's ex-wife who divorced from him 4 years ago. They used to be a very loving couple and had sex every day, however after their divorce she changed completely and kept switching from a man to another while becoming better at sex.
At first Kikyou was planning on using [url=/c63211]Iori's[/url] office in order to get pregnant, but after learning about the protagonist working at the rival company, she started planning out her revenge on him.
